recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The current build no longer publishes the retired resource folders or standalone Statistic/OrderedDistribution datatype pages, and the remaining active ModelInfo surface now matches that state. Historical release notes, old-type terminology, removed-resource lists, and migration notes should remain as historical context.
issue_request: FHIR-26967 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request, applied for R5, asking to delete unused EffectEvidenceSynthesis, RiskEvidenceSynthesis, and Statistic resource artifacts, remove the retired resources from resource-name-tracker.xml, add removed-resource entries, and fix the then-current Statistic and OrderedDistribution datatype page linking.
initial_application: Commit 990b2a3dc9b66819a3d8e6bc880c55dded7fc294 appears to have applied the original request by adding fhir.ini type-page mappings for Statistic and OrderedDistribution, adding EffectEvidenceSynthesis and RiskEvidenceSynthesis under [removed-resources], deleting their resource-name-tracker rows, and deleting the old resource folders. Current source already has the retired resources in [removed-resources], lacks the old folders, and has no resource-name-tracker rows for them.
additional_context: FHIR-31564 and FHIR-31866 later removed OrderedDistribution and Statistic as standalone datatypes and folded Statistic into Evidence, so restoring FHIR-26967's old type-page mappings would be wrong. The current build still has Library as an active resource and includes Library/FHIR-ModelInfo as an example, but that FHIR 6.0.0 ModelInfo content still listed EffectEvidenceSynthesis and RiskEvidenceSynthesis as retrievable resources before reconciliation.
reconciliation: Removed EffectEvidenceSynthesis and RiskEvidenceSynthesis ModelInfo resource definitions, nested type definitions, and Resource choices from source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml, then regenerated the embedded base64 payload in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml to keep the Library example synchronized.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: removed EffectEvidenceSynthesis and RiskEvidenceSynthesis ClassInfo blocks, nested ClassInfo blocks, and Resource choice entries.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: regenerated the embedded application/xml base64 content so Library/FHIR-ModelInfo matches the external ModelInfo XML.
